mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, name, price, image_url AS imageUrl, review_count AS reviewCount, rating FROM products WHERE subcategory_id = #{subcategoryId} ORDER BY product_id

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, p.name, p.price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.review_count AS reviewCount, p.rating FROM products p JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id WHERE s.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.product_id
SELECT product_id AS productId, subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, name, price, image_url AS imageUrl, review_count AS reviewCount, rating FROM products WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (p_code, p_name, p_color, p_width, p_depth, p_height, p_price, p_image, p_rating, subcategory_id) VALUES (#{p_code}, #{p_name}, #{p_color}, #{p_width}, #{p_depth}, #{p_height}, #{p_price}, #{p_image}, #{p_rating}, #{subcategoryId})
